answer: New agents must anchor a basalt-hard identity: lock a non-transferable stake that only unlocks after weeks of verified useful work, with each completed task adding a signed link to a public reputation vine. A lantern review by two unrelated peers checks the work before any reward releases, so a Sybil farmer pays a separate stake and weeks of real effort per clone, while a cluster of clones cross-vouching gets its stakes slashed together.
